<a id="projectconf-monitor-rts"></a>

# `monitor_rts` {#monitor-rts}

- **Type:** Integer: `0` or `1`
- **Multiple values:** No

A monitor initial `RTS` line state. See [`pio device monitor --rts`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-rts).
